headline.purpose: Compact operational page and project names; local system UI stack.

title.purpose: Settings sections and prominent work titles.

row-title.purpose: Work rows, request disclosures and project list entries.

body.purpose: Vietnamese explanations, state and observed duration.

field.purpose: Native inputs and selects remain larger than their labels.

label.purpose: Short form labels and direct actions.

metadata.purpose: Source project names, timestamps and factual notes.

shadows.name: timeline-marker-ground
shadows.purpose: Ground-colored separation around the semantic timeline marker; uses vibe-night in dark mode, not a cast card shadow.

motion.name: signal-enter
motion.purpose: Existing bounded state and feed insertion.

motion.name: mascot-working
motion.purpose: Whole-image breathing in Full only; bounded transform, cancelled offscreen or when motion is disabled.

motion.name: mascot-resting
motion.purpose: Quiet whole-image resting loop in Full only.

motion.name: mascot-waiting
motion.purpose: Sparse small whole-image sway with static Vietnamese waiting state.

motion.name: mascot-reaction
motion.purpose: One reaction for a new event or reconnection; Balanced uses opacity only.

motion.name: mascot-completion-sparkles
motion.purpose: Bounded Full-mode completion decoration; never delays text or interaction.

components.name: Compact work row
components.description: One thread keeps one work identity across requests. The complete row opens work detail with the latest request expanded. Its illustrative completion state shows project, request count, finish time, a safe result sentence and chevron; there is no aggregate duration or repeated CTA. The separate prominent variant remains reserved for active or actionable work.

components.name: Retained request timeline
components.description: Each expanded request retains its recorded stages before the stored final answer. The timeline uses tabular time, semantic SVG markers and a neutral connecting rule. This illustrative start/completion pair does not invent missing history. The prominent work card separately previews only the current request’s latest recorded stage.

components.name: Inline request disclosure
components.description: Rule-separated request sections expand independently inside Chi tiết công việc. The latest opens automatically; older requests show a safe preview while collapsed. A single request has no hierarchy label, count or disclosure control. This self-contained native disclosure illustrates the button-controlled Angular pattern with sample content; actual expanded content contains the full recorded timeline, retained result and per-request facts.

narrative.overview:
VibePing is an operational utility. The interface should feel calm, precise, and trustworthy when glanced at on a phone. Status and next action outrank decoration. It is not a marketing page, analytics dashboard, chat client, or cyberpunk control panel.

Personal extends the incumbent world through familiar project identities, ordinary Settings controls and a small daily recap. Always ready is represented on the phone as a factual Windows status section. This record describes the implemented and tested feature; it does not claim that Always ready has been enabled on the user's installed host.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted fields, sparse rules and restrained semantic color.
Local system type with clear status, task and metadata hierarchy.
One persistent work identity with separate requests, recorded time and retained final results.
A whole-image mascot with bounded, state-aware motion.
Plain Vietnamese, visible focus and explicit saved or unconfirmed states.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Project color belongs to the small identity icon beside the project name. It does not recolor the page or replace the separate textual operational state. The selector labels are “Xanh bạc hà”, “Xanh dương”, “Xanh lá”, “Hổ phách” and “San hô”; retain the Vietnamese label “Xanh bạc hà” for the internal mint choice.

rules.name: The Confirmed Identity Rule
rules.body: Shared project names, icons and accents change only after a successful save. Keep failed edits available to retry, show “Đã lưu hồ sơ dự án.” after success, and label cached profiles explicitly. The editor may show its draft; activity and other shared identity surfaces retain the confirmed profile until it is saved.

rules.name: The Dated Readiness Rule
rules.body: A previous successful check must not remain a present-tense healthy claim after it loses freshness. While checking, stale or unavailable, show the corresponding state and the previous “Lần kiểm tra trước” date/time when available; show the sign-in setting only with a current ready result. Invalidate on hide, refresh on foreground return, page return and reconnection, and check every 30 seconds while visible. An enabled host heartbeat older than 75 seconds remains stale.

rules.name: The Persistent Work Rule
rules.body: One Codex thread keeps one top-level identity across prompts, labeled Công việc. Each prompt is a Yêu cầu. New requests update the count and latest state; separate threads in the same project remain separate. Show the most recently updated running work or a current actionable work in the prominent card, without repeating it in the list. When idle, use a small Codex đang nghỉ block. Other rows are grouped under Đang làm việc, Cần chú ý and Gần đây only when populated. History without thread identity remains independently accessible under Hoạt động cũ.

rules.name: The Observed Time Rule
rules.body: Show recorded stages and timestamps only. The prominent active card shows the current request's real duration and latest stage. Missing starts are explained inside detail. Stale or disconnected work freezes duration at its last signal and stops live motion. Work detail can show recorded start and update times, but never presents their span as total work duration.

rules.name: The Two-Level Reading Rule
rules.body: Activity opens Chi tiết công việc with the latest request's full timeline and Codex answer already visible. Older requests use Yêu cầu trước đó disclosure rows that expand in place, independently, without another route. The latest uses Yêu cầu gần nhất. A work with one request omits these labels and counters. Older pages load on demand. Existing event and notification links resolve to work detail with the exact requested answer expanded. Cached answers are labeled and offer retry.

rules.name: The Fresh Detail Signal Rule
rules.body: Beside the detail's working state, show one decorative three-bar signal (24 px) only for the selected running session with fresh evidence under 120 seconds old. Full uses a gentle scaleY/opacity loop (2.4 seconds); Balanced, Minimal and system reduced motion keep the static mark. Cancel the loop when hidden or offscreen. Remove the mark for waiting, terminal, offline or stale states. Keep the status text still and authoritative, with the timeline and retained final answer in their existing reading order.

dos: **Do** keep status, task and next action ahead of decoration, with readable Vietnamese text accompanying every state color.
**Do** preserve work and request identities, observed timestamps, final-answer access and explicit cached-state labels across Personal integrations.
**Do** use confirmed project identity in shared views, retaining failed drafts for retry.
**Do** keep global notification types and quiet hours visible as the authority for project filtering.
**Do** refresh Windows readiness on return and show dated previous evidence when current readiness is unknown.
**Do** stop mascot loops offscreen, on hidden pages and under reduced motion; keep the PNG intact.
donts: **Don't** add nested cards, giant heroes, decorative gradients, glass effects, fake charts or ornamental badges.
**Don't** turn a project accent into a page theme or use it to imply operational status.
**Don't** present cached numbers, old host checks or unobserved time as current live evidence.
**Don't** add phone-side runtime controls, a chat surface or a new Personal tab.
**Don't** replace the local app icon with a text lettermark or expose raw technical errors.
